label: n after 1 at step 3-4 in sequences starting with t
explanation: Extremely sparse (29 of 1M sequences). Every activation is input token n immediately after digit 1, at original-phase step 3 (rarely 4), in sequences whose first token is t (pattern t ? 1 n). Magnitude depends on the intermediate token: highest with h (t h 1 n), lower for u, j, z, x, near zero for i or digits. Never fires at step 2 (t 1 n), in the delimiter or copy phase, or on any other token. Predicate has full recall but only ~40% precision on dev because many t ? 1 n contexts stay silent.
